findings.desc: quality-correctness: scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:599 verifies the overlap matrix by role count/presence only; it never compares roleMatrix fields against the baseline or regenerated Markdown, so status/phase/purpose/commands/notes drift in the committed baseline or matrix can pass while the verifier prints overlap matrix verified. Compare each roleMatrix field and the rendered Markdown content to the committed file.
findings.resolvedReason: Verifier now compares every roleMatrix field in current generated defaults against baseline JSON, requires all roleMatrix fields for all 16 roles, and compares normalized regenerated Markdown against docs/requirements/baselines/proof-or-stop-prompt-overlap-matrix.md with line/hash mismatch output. Evidence: npm --prefix packages/main run build PASS; node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs PASS; npm run test:proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline PASS.

findings.desc: M0.3 requires the role-overlap matrix to cover phase, commands, direct file access, output artifact, and overlap category, but the generated matrix table has columns for Role/Status/Phase/Purpose/Commands/Inputs/Outputs/Capabilities/Overlap category/Notes and no direct-file-access column or per-role field. The baseline JSON roleMatrix objects likewise contain role/status/phase/purpose/commands/inputs/outputs/capabilities/overlapCategory/notes only, so direct file access is not systematically covered for all 16 roles; it only appears incidentally in the story-init note while the separate directStoryFileReferences section is not part of the overlap matrix.
findings.resolvedReason: Added directFileAccess to ROLE_MATRIX_DEFAULTS for all 16 roles, regenerated baseline JSON roleMatrix with directFileAccess for every role, and regenerated docs/requirements/baselines/proof-or-stop-prompt-overlap-matrix.md with a Direct file access column. Evidence: npm --prefix packages/main run build PASS; node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs PASS; npm run test:proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline PASS.

findings.desc: CHK-005:adversarial:0 lacks valid verification coverage for actionable edit instructions. The committed classifier recognizes only shell redirection or echo as direct-write; exact in-memory execution of classifyStoryFinding classifies explicit Edit, Write, tee, and sed -i instructions targeting docs/story as other with grandfathered:true, and verifyNoUnregisteredDirectStoryWrite skips non-direct-write findings. The current passing verifier evidence therefore does not prove the required distinction between harmless policy reminders and actionable edit instructions. Add committed adversarial cases for non-redirection write forms and make them fail closed as direct-write.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 6aef18eb8: the direct-story classifier now fails closed for actionable Edit, Write, tee, sed -i, Directly Read/Edit, and conditional echo/redirection targeting docs/story while preserving genuinely negative reminders, with committed adversarial probes. Current materialHash 69f774ee02a1edeac5a6f9b62f987ea59d9ef709bdba5df0dd1da65c717e9a1c was reverified and recorded by 591b314ae. npm --prefix packages/main run build passed with @lattice/core@0.3.179 build and tsc. node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs passed all seven lines: PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: roleCount=16 registry hashes verified; PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: agent_prompt output hashes verified for 16 roles; PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: overlap matrix verified for 16 roles; PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: exhaustive role matrix source claims verified for 16 roles; PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: role matrix unsupported-claim mutation probe rejected; PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: legacy vocabulary findings classified; PASS proof-or-stop prompt baseline: direct story-file findings classified. node scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs --probe-direct-story-classifier passed: PASS direct story-file classifier adversarial probes: 9 cases. npm run test:proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline passed with the same seven PASS lines.

findings.desc: responsibility-boundary: M0.3 is not a truthful command/output ownership inventory. The committed matrix assigns scope_check_save to lattice-review-behavior even though that prompt only consumes the scope-plan artifact and the source plan reserves scope_check_save writes to scope-plan; it also assigns reviewer-run/finding/pass writes to evaluator/delivery rows whose role-specific contracts are raw JSON or delivery_check_set-only, while product-reviewer is listed with commands=none despite its conditional init_check_set call. The verifier cannot detect these semantic errors because collectCurrentBaseline builds current.roleMatrix from the same hard-coded ROLE_MATRIX_DEFAULTS that seed the baseline/Markdown, then verifyMatrix checks only parity with those constants. As a result it prints overlap matrix verified for a false responsibility boundary. Audit and correct all 16 command/output rows against the role-specific prompt contracts and add an independent source-backed semantic check or explicitly stop claiming semantic verification.

quality-correctness: scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:318 classifies any docs/story line containing directly read/edit as a policy reminder before write detection, while scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:343 only recognizes echo or a narrow shell redirection. Executing the changed classifier against actionable examples classified Directly Read/Edit as policy-reminder, tee as other with grandfathered=true, and If available, echo x > docs/story/... as read-only-reference with grandfathered=true. scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs:724 then enforces only findings already classified direct-write, so an intentional baseline refresh can admit actionable direct-story writes without the required explicit grandfathering and CLI-gap justification. This breaks the CHK-005 promised distinction and leaves a direct-write regression bypass.

doc-promise-undelivered: scripts/verify-proof-or-stop-prompt-baseline.mjs prints that the overlap matrix is verified, but collectCurrentBaseline builds roleMatrix only from hardcoded ROLE_MATRIX_DEFAULTS and verifyMatrix only compares those defaults with the committed JSON/Markdown; it never checks matrix facts against the prompt bodies or source-plan contracts. Concrete drift is already present: matrix line 22 says product-reviewer commands are none although its prompt lines 31-39 mandate init_check_set; line 13 assigns scope_check_save to lattice-review-behavior although its prompt only consumes that artifact and writes finding/pass; line 14 lists dispatch for lattice-review-channel although that reviewer only inspects dispatch evidence; and line 12 claims lattice-implementer outputs verificationEvidence although its whitelist limits checklist_update to status/times. Correct the rows and add prompt/contract-backed assertions before emitting the verified claim.

doc-code-drift: .lattice/story/actives/B-3928/evidence/delivery-context-pack.json claims to snapshot the current diff, and marks transcriptDiff=true, but its diff.changedFiles list and summary omit .lattice/story/actives/B-3928/evidence/transcript-diff.md. A direct comparison with git diff --name-only main...HEAD shows that file as the sole mismatch. Refresh the delivery context from the current committed diff so the transcript evidence package is internally consistent.

delivery-evidence-scope: .lattice/story/actives/B-3928/evidence/delivery-context-pack.json:5 records 25 changed files and sets transcriptDiff=true, but a direct comparison with git diff main...HEAD --name-only found 26 committed files; the omitted file is .lattice/story/actives/B-3928/evidence/transcript-diff.md. The pack also has no top-level captured head or scope hash that would identify this as an older snapshot. A delivery reviewer consuming this pack can therefore miss the newly added transcript evidence while being told the transcript diff is present. Regenerate the pack after adding the transcript diff, or bind the pack to an explicit captured commit and complete file list.
